Figure 6. (A) Dose-dependent evaluation of 1 suspending AD activity
in N2aSW cells. (B) MAPRE3 is necessary for 1 to suspend AD in

and then treated with compounds for 48 h, followed by determination
of the levels of APP, Aβ1−42, and GPX4 by Western blot. Data
represent means ± SEM values of three experiments. *P < 0.05, **P <
0.01 compared with control alone. NS represents no statistical
significance.
